summary: Iteration 4 — Commission-based financial tracking end-to-end validation. Backend: 5/5 new pytest in test_commission_stats.py pass (stats shape with new keys, ticket_medio = total_vendido/qtd_vendas, a-vista commission_received=true → increments only comissao_recebida, a-vista commission_received=false → increments only comissao_a_receber, parcelado with past-due installment → vencida contains only the overdue one, PATCH /sales/{id}/installments/{n} moves the amount from a_receber to recebida AND removes it from vencida). Baseline from the public /api/stats?year=2026 confirms the user’s note: comissao_recebida=R$0,00, comissao_a_receber=R$608.970,00=comissao_total. Frontend master dashboard: all 8 KPIs render with the correct testids and labels (kpi-total-vendas-mes 'VGV (Total Vendido)', kpi-comissao-total 'Comissão Gerada', kpi-comissao-recebida, kpi-comissao-a-receber, kpi-comissao-vencida, kpi-comissao-corretor, kpi-ticket-medio, kpi-qtd-vendas); no 'Falta Entrar' / 'Falta entrar' / 'Já Recebi' strings anywhere on the page. SaleFormDialog has both switches (sale-form-parcelado-switch and, when parcelado is OFF, sale-form-commission-received-switch); turning parcelado ON hides the received toggle; typing commission_value=1500 + num=3 + 'Gerar parcelas' creates 3 rows of exactly R$500 (confirmed via DOM read) — i.e. derived from commission_value, NOT from sale_value. InstallmentsDialog (btn-installments-{id}) opens with title 'Comissão a receber' and three summary chips Recebida / A receber / Vencida visible. Corretor regression: login carlos.teste@brilhantes.com / 12345678900 succeeds; CorretorDashboard shows exactly 6 KPIs including 'Comissão Recebida' R$0,00 and 'Comissão a Receber' R$35.200,00; strings 'Já Recebi' and 'Falta Entrar' are absent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 1283 lines — split into routers (auth/sales/loteamentos/corretores/stats) for maintainability (recurring from iter 3).

Stats endpoint returns both the new keys (comissao_recebida, comissao_a_receber) and legacy aliases (ja_entrou, falta_entrar) with the SAME commission-based values; this is backwards-compatible but could mislead a future developer into thinking lot-balance is still exposed — add a comment or deprecate the legacy keys.

_comm_overdue reads today() in UTC but due_date is a plain ISO date (local). For users in BRT (-03:00) between 21:00–23:59 local, 'today' in UTC is already tomorrow which can prematurely flag an installment as overdue (or vice-versa). Prefer comparing against a Brazil-timezone date.

There is still a duplicate data-testid='sale-form-broker-select' comment carried from iter 3; the component now uses distinct sale-form-broker-locked + sale-form-broker-select — confirmed OK, flag resolved.

The commission tests are pinned to xdist_group='commission_stats' so they share one worker; running with the full suite -n auto is safe. For the frontend, inject session_token cookie value qa_session_vinicius_001 for master; carlos.teste@brilhantes.com / 12345678900 for corretor. The sale form generates installments from commission_value (sale-form-commission-value), NOT sale_value — do not test with only sale_value filled.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced in this iteration. The requested behaviour (financial control based on COMMISSION, not on lot balance) is implemented correctly in backend helpers _comm_received/_comm_pending/_comm_overdue and surfaced in the frontend KpiGrid / InstallmentsDialog / SaleFormDialog / CorretorDashboard. Initial test failures were pytest-xdist cross-worker interference on the shared /api/stats aggregate; fixed by pinning the module to a single xdist group.
